trello.name: Defer dark mode build to September design-system upgrade
trello.desc: Okay, scratch what I just said. We are not building dark mode this cycle. It comes for free with the September design-system upgrade, so no task there, and if anyone asks, that's the answer.

trello.name: Stay on Postgres, no MongoDB migration or evaluation
trello.desc: Agreed. Let's settle it now: we're staying on Postgres, no migration, no evaluation task, I don't want that on the board.

trello.name: Benchmark PgBouncer connection pooling for dashboard performance
trello.desc: The dashboard is slow for accounts with lots of projects. I profiled it: 80% of the time is waiting on the database, and it's connection contention, not query cost. But the contention is real, so Raj, take a proper look at connection pooling instead. Benchmark PgBouncer in transaction mode against our current setup, with the dashboard workload, and bring numbers next sync. Raj: Will do. I'll set up a load test that mirrors the dashboard's query pattern and compare p95 latency with and without PgBouncer.

trello.name: Fix typo in onboarding email subject line
trello.desc: Marketing spotted a typo in the onboarding email, it says "recieve" in the subject line, of all places. Tom, just fix it and get it re-approved, five-minute job. Tom: On it. I'll push the fix through the email template repo today.

trello.name: Update roadmap doc to move dark mode under September design-system upgrade
trello.desc: And the roadmap doc still shows dark mode under "Q3 committed", which after today is wrong. Tom, while you're in there, update the roadmap: move dark mode under the September design-system upgrade line so sales stops promising it as standalone. Tom: Got it, I'll update the doc right after this.
